offerings.name: Search
offerings.pricing: Hobby: $16/month billed yearly for 5,000 credits/month (2,500 searches or 5,000 pages scraped). Pay-as-you-go: $5 per increment; 1,000 credits on Hobby, 2,000 on Standard, 2,500 on Growth, and 5,000 on Scale.
offerings.free_quota: Free Plan: 1,000 credits / month; 500 searches or 1,000 pages scraped.
offerings.output_type: 结构化搜索结果（web、news、images），可选返回每个结果的完整页面 markdown、HTML、links 或 screenshots。
offerings.note: Search costs 2 credits per 10 results，按每 10 个结果向上取整；搜索与抓取共用 credits。
